verdict.rationale: Filee is an offline, local desktop file converter. Per its docs, nothing is uploaded and files never leave the user's computer, so it holds no user data that would need exporting before leaving. Its many open-format conversions are the product's core function applied to the user's own files, not a data-export or portability capability, so the 'export all my data and leave' axis does not apply to this kind of product.
